question: The birth centenary of which famous Indian hockey captain was celebrated on 2 February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __"____**Kunwar Digvijay Singh ‘Babu**__’".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian field hockey player **Kunwar Digvijay Singh**,__ also known as "Babu," played the sport from 2 February 1922 until 27 March 1978.
 
• He was born in Uttar Pradesh's **Barabanki**.
 
• He is well known for his captivating passing ability and is regarded by many as the best scorer in the game, next only to **Dhyan Chand**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• As the finest hockey player in the world (1952) and the best sportsman in Asia, Singh was awarded the **Helms Trophy** in 1953. (1953).
 
• The Helms Trophy was given to an **Indian** for the first time ever.
 
• He received the prestigious **Padmashri** award from the Indian government in 1958.
 
• He has stadiums named after him in **Barabanki** and **Lucknow**. Both the K. D. Singh Babu Stadiums in Lucknow and Barabanki are so named.
 
• He has a street in Barabanki City named after him that runs between **Chhaya Chauraha***** ***and Lucknow-**Faizabad Road**.
